content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-86. - Interest coupons.
content.summary:
Except for such bonds which are registrable for payment of interest, interest coupons
               payable to bearer shall be attached to the bonds and shall bear the original or the
               facsimile signature of any officer of the city as provided by the council.
